result.basis: Hypothetical witnesses checked by the existing participant-witness engine; conditional on declared survivors, variables and the premises each request names.
result.limits: Hypothetical evidence requests over the declared surviving candidates and declared variables only. No row is an observation, premise or recommendation, and no row claims that such evidence exists. The declared family does not exhaust real protocols; corpus silence never supplies a negative witness.

requests.seek: Participation records bound to eligibility at entry, such as baseline characteristics or enrolled-participant listings for the same measurement and time, with an eligibility bridge.

Eligibility-attributed screening or adjudication records, such as screening logs or screen-failure reasons for this profile. Registry participant-flow categories rarely identify the profile or the failed criterion, and corpus silence is never a rejected witness.

limits_of_claim: Caller labels do not independently verify source truth or confirmation.
Exact representation comparison is not clinical semantic equivalence.
A represented restriction is not full patient eligibility.
All analysis inputs are replay dependencies; only claimed support or actual deciding warrants weaken a finding.
